_readme: Performer-booking MVP eligibility, applied by scripts/fetch-events.js at
ingest. Every event in events.json gets an explicit `performer_requests`
boolean (default FALSE). Events flagged true show a secondary
'🎤 Interested in performing?' CTA on their card in the WordPress plugin,
which opens a short interest form emailed to the admin. See
PERFORMER_REQUESTS.md at the repo root for the full experiment doc.
An event is flagged performer_requests=true when `enabled` is true AND
ANY of these hold:
1. `include_open_mics` is true and the event has is_open_mic=true
(classification from config/open-mics.json).
2. It matches an enabled entry in `series_allowlist`: title_match is a
case-insensitive substring of the event title (hyphens normalized to
spaces), and venue_match (if present) a case-insensitive substring
of the venue name.
3. It matches an enabled entry in `venue_rules`: venue_match is a
substring of the venue name; if `title_include` is present the title
must contain at least one of its keywords (omit it to cover EVERY
show at the venue); any `title_exclude` keyword in the title vetoes
the flag. All matching is case-insensitive substring, hyphens in
titles normalized to spaces — same as series_allowlist.
To turn the whole experiment off: set `enabled` to false (takes effect
on the next fetch run, ~twice daily, or run scripts/fetch-events.js).
To turn one show/series on or off: add/edit its series_allowlist entry
and set `enabled` on that entry.
Keep the cohort to local multi-comic lineups: open mics, recurring
showcases, independent productions. Never flag nationally touring
headliner shows (single named headliner at a major club) — a booking
request there is noise for everyone.
Deliberately a boolean for the MVP, not a status enum. If the experiment
graduates, migrate to performer_request_status:
disabled | testing | producer_unverified | producer_verified |
producer_accepting — the ingest stamping point in fetch-events.js is the
single place to change.

venue_rules.note: Owner call 2026-08-08: essentially everything The Secret Group runs is a local multi-comic production (C U Next Tuesday, The Last Laugh with Shane & Trip, The Late Night Dirty Show, ...), so flag the whole venue and veto only headliner-branded titles ('Best of TSG Headliner Series - <name>', 'Secret Headliner with ...'). The extra excludes are current MUSIC bookings at the venue (UnoTheActivist, Sorry Ghost, Wax) — a performer CTA on a concert is noise. Keep adding one-off touring/music titles here as they appear; bare-name touring comics (e.g. 'Jed Harrelson', 'Abby Govindan') currently stay flagged per the venue-wide call — veto individually if submissions there turn out to be junk.

Matches both Riot rooms (Houston + Conroe). The Riot's bread and butter is touring-headliner shows, so this is include-based: only obviously-local multi-comic formats (showcase / best of / late night / late show / open mic / new faces) get the CTA, and headliner wording still vetoes. 'late show' added after the first live harvest — 'Saturday Night Standup Comedy Late Show!' is the showcase's late slot, not a headliner set. Extend title_include as more recurring Riot formats show up in the StandupTix feed.

series_allowlist.note: Free booked bar showcases at Notsuoh, Social Beer Garden HTX, and Big Ben Tavern (~29 upcoming instances). Owner-confirmed booked shows (2026-07-24) — exactly the concierge target. No venue_match on purpose: all three rooms.
Weekly independent Thursday showcase, Eventbrite-listed, local production.

'Best of Houston'-style multi-comic showcase, several time slots per weekend (7/8/9/10pm + Rated R 11pm). Covers 'The Best of the Secret Group Comedy Showcase' and 'RATED R' variants; deliberately does NOT match 'Best of TSG Headliner Series - <name>' (single named headliner).
'$2 BILL Two Dollar Comedy Show every Wednesday!' — weekly local showcase.
The Den's rotating multi-comic club showcase, multiple nights per week. The Den is an existing Eventbrite feed partner.
